before_tex: \begin{aligned}a\times b & =({a}_{1}i+{a}_{2}j+{a}_{3}k)\times ({b}_{1}i+{b}_{2}j+{b}_{3}k) \\  & =({a}_{1}\cdot {b}_{1})i\times i+({a}_{1}\cdot {b}_{2})i\times j+({a}_{1}\cdot {b}_{3})i\times k \\  & +({a}_{2}\cdot {b}_{1})j\times i+({a}_{2}\cdot {b}_{2})j\times j+({a}_{2}\cdot {b}_{3})j\times k \\  & +({a}_{3}\cdot {b}_{1})k\times i+({a}_{3}\cdot {b}_{2})k\times j+({a}_{3}\cdot {b}_{3})k\times k.\end{aligned}

\begin{aligned}a\times b & =({a}_{1}\cdot {b}_{1})\underbrace{i\times i}_{=0}+({a}_{1}\cdot {b}_{2})\underbrace{i\times j}_{=k}+({a}_{1}\cdot {b}_{3})\underbrace{i\times k}_{=-j} \\  & +({a}_{2}\cdot {b}_{1})\underbrace{j\times i}_{=-k}+({a}_{2}\cdot {b}_{2})\underbrace{j\times j}_{=0}+({a}_{2}\cdot {b}_{3})\underbrace{j\times k}_{=i} \\  & +({a}_{3}\cdot {b}_{1})\underbrace{k\times i}_{=j}+({a}_{3}\cdot {b}_{2})\underbrace{k\times j}_{=-i}+({a}_{3}\cdot {b}_{3})\underbrace{k\times k}_{=0} \\  & =({a}_{2}{b}_{3}-{a}_{3}{b}_{2})i-({a}_{1}{b}_{3}-{a}_{3}{b}_{1})j+({a}_{1}{b}_{2}-{a}_{2}{b}_{1})k.\end{aligned}
